title: 选词中的指代关系
goal: 追踪跨句指代并选择与所指对象一致的词语。

points.label: 确定跨句代词所指的对象
根据指代关系选择衔接词语

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 代词和概括名词（如 this change）用来指前文的事物或事件。空格在这类词附近时，先找出它指的是什么，再选词。
例如 A library bought a new table. It stands by the window. 句中的 it 指 table。先看单复数是否一致，再看句意是否通顺。

cards.title: 代词的数
rows: The library bought a table. It stands by the window.
The team fixed a gate. It now opens easily.
The students planted trees. They now grow beside the path.
The library ordered books. They arrived yesterday.
The group collected tools. These were stored in a box.
The town planted flowers. These now grow near the station.

cards.title: 概括名词
rows: The class moved the meeting. This decision gave everyone more time.
The shop opened earlier. This change helped morning customers.
The town proposed a new path. Such a plan needs funding.
Students read and discuss articles. Such activities build language skills.
阅读和讨论文章的活动

cards.title: 指代与意义
rows: The bridge was repaired. It is now safe.
it 指桥。桥修好后才安全。
The tank was emptied. It now holds no water.
it 指水箱。emptied 对应 no water。
The signs were removed. They are no longer on the doors.
they 指标志。标志原来在门上。
The class changed its schedule. This change moved the lesson to Friday.
this change 指课表的调整。

body.box:
The team planted trees beside the path. They will provide _____ on sunny days.
1. shade
2. fruit
3. tools
4. paths

body.p: they 指 trees，后句讲树在晴天的作用。树在晴天提供树荫，即第一项 shade。第二项 fruit 也由树提供，但与 on sunny days 无关。

items.stem: The school bought a piano. It was placed in the hall. What does it refer to?
items.why: placed in the hall 描述被放入大厅的钢琴，it 指 piano。

items.stem: Workers planted trees. They now grow beside the road. What does they refer to?
items.why: grow beside the road 描述树木，they 指 trees。

items.stem: The class moved its meeting to Friday so members had more days to prepare. This _____ provided extra preparation time before the meeting.
items.why: this change 概括把会议改到星期五的调整。

items.stem: The shop ordered new books. They arrived in two _____ made of cardboard.
items.why: they 指 books；书装在两个箱子里送达。

groups.text: A library moved its chairs to a quiet room. They are now near the windows. The library also extended its opening hours. This change lets visitors stay later in the evening.

items.stem: What does they refer to in the second sentence?
items.why: 前句的 chairs 被搬到安静的房间，they 指这些椅子。

items.stem: This change refers to the longer opening _____.
items.why: this change 承接前句延长开放时间的行为，即 longer opening hours。

items.stem: The gardener planted a tree. It now stands beside the gate. What does it refer to?
items.why: 前句种下的树如今位于门旁，it 指 tree。

items.stem: The library ordered books. They arrived yesterday. What does they refer to?
items.why: 前句订购的书昨天送达，they 指 books。

items.stem: The school moved the chairs. These are now in the hall. What does these refer to?
items.why: 前句搬动的椅子如今在大厅，these 指 chairs。

items.stem: The team decided to meet earlier. This decision saved time. What does this decision refer to?
options: A decision to cancel the meeting
A decision to delay the meeting
A decision to change the team
items.why: this decision 承接前句决定提前开会的事件。

items.stem: The gate was repaired. It now opens _____.
items.why: it 指修好的门。门修好后容易打开，即 opens easily。第二项 badly 与 repaired 的结果相反。

items.stem: The class changed its schedule. This _____ moved the lesson to Friday.
items.why: this change 概括前句 changed its schedule 这一调整。第三项 schedule 是被调整的对象，不是调整这件事。

items.stem: Students read and discuss articles. Such _____ involve both reading and speaking.
items.why: such activities 概括阅读和讨论文章的活动。

items.stem: The library bought a lamp. It provides _____ for evening reading.
items.why: it 指 lamp；灯为晚间阅读提供光线。
